picks.question: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 3.5% for the year ending in September 2026?
picks.why: Inflation still above 3.5% would constrain Fed rate cuts and erode real wages heading into 2027.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices and inflation risks elevated.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state wealth tax on billionaires would test capital mobility, revenue estimates, and whether taxing wealth is administratively workable.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: A trillion-dollar-plus OpenAI debut would signal how much public investors will pay for AI's expected future earnings.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership at the AI frontier shapes where capital, talent, and productivity gains concentrate in the coming tech cycle.

picks.question: Will an AI lab announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2026?
picks.why: An AI-produced solution to a famous open math problem would mark a leap from research tool to genuine contributor.
